overview: Extract ListDetailViewModel from ListDetailView (526 lines). View currently mixes @Query, drag-drop reorder, nesting, quick capture, completion, scheduling, and rendering. VM takes all business logic; view becomes a thin consumer.
goals: Create @Observable ListDetailViewModel owning flat node computation, drag-drop, completion lifecycle, quick capture, scheduling, and deletion
Gut ListDetailView from ~526 lines to ~200 lines of pure view code
All mutations go through VM methods, testable without view lifecycle
nonGoals: No behavioral changes to existing UI
No changes to SwiftData models or queries
successMetrics: ListDetailViewModel.swift created with all expected methods
ListDetailView.swift delegates to VM, no direct modelContext mutations
All drag-drop, completion, quick capture, schedule, and delete workflows work identically
rules: View holds @Query, passes data to VM via update()
VM receives modelContext at init from view's @Environment
UI-only state (@FocusState, editMode) stays in view

stories.title: Create ListDetailViewModel with core properties and update() entry point
stories.description: Create the ViewModel file with @Observable class, init, update() entry point, and computed/derived state properties.
acceptanceCriteria: update(tasks:lists:allTasks:now:) stores data and recomputes derived state
list, tasks, rootTasks computed properties added
flatNodes, flattenTasks(), flattenNode() with collapse support added (task 1.5)
justCompleted set with toggleCompletion(for:) including animation delay added (task 1.7)

stories.title: Move data mutations to ViewModel
stories.description: Add all mutation methods to the ViewModel: quick capture, deletion, move-to-list, drag-drop reorder, scheduling, rescheduling.
acceptanceCriteria: commitQuickCapture(text:in:) creates TaskItem with list assignment (2.1)
delete(task:) cancels notification and removes task (2.2)
moveTask(_:to:) and assignSortOrder(for:in:) for list moves (2.3)
presentScheduleSheet(for:) and scheduleTask(_:dueDate:hasTime:), reschedule helpers added (2.6)

stories.title: Refactor ListDetailView to use ViewModel
stories.description: Wire the ViewModel into the view. Replace all computed properties, mutation methods, and direct modelContext usage with VM calls.
acceptanceCriteria: View creates VM from environment modelContext (3.1)
All computed properties replaced with viewModel. references (3.2)
All private mutation methods replaced with viewModel. calls (3.3)
No direct modelContext mutations remain in view (3.7)
